scripts.playground: bun run build && bun -e "Bun.serve({ port: 3456, fetch(req) { const p = new URL(req.url).pathname; if (p === '/' || p === '/index.html') return new Response(Bun.file('playground/index.html')); if (p.startsWith('/dist/')) return new Response(Bun.file('.' + p)); if (p === '/controls.js') return new Response(Bun.file('playground/controls.js')); return new Response('Not Found', { status: 404 }); } }); console.log('Playground: http://localhost:3456');"
